title: Strange behavior of editable children's resources whose base scene leaves those (resources) empty.
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.1stable, 4.6stable ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7628) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12490F (12 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory ### Issue description Actually, I've identified two issues, not one, but since I discovered them simultaneously, I'm reporting them together for now. Please let me know if it would be better to open a separate issue for either one. ﻿ First, the major issue occurs in both versions 4.5.1 and 4.6: When a resource is left empty in a base scene, and the Editable Children feature is enabled in an instance, any resource added within the instance can only be edited after performing both "Save Scene" and "Switching Scene Tabs". Demo for the major issue: (in 4.5.1) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9eb275d8-040f-4c95-b3e2-0e77ecd8fc14 (in 4.6) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8b93c514-21ad-4f32-b73c-84e4d43e9e50 ﻿ The second, minor issue is specific to version 4.6 stable: I believe the resources in such an instance (even before saving the scene) should not be marked as resources shared with the base scene, since the base scene has left that resource slot empty. Screenshot for the minor one (the link icon will disappear after you save the scene): ### Steps to reproduce 1. Add a new resource to instances' editable children 2. Try to edit it, you will find you can't 3. Save the scene, switch scene tab once, then try to edit it ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [new_game_project_2026-01-31_02-20-17.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24971782/new_game_project_2026-01-31_02-20-17.zip)
